C1.text: Monthly uptime must be at least 99.9% (about 43.2 minutes of downtime allowed in a 30-day month).
If uptime is missed, the client receives a service credit of 5% of the monthly fee for up to 60 minutes beyond the allowance and 10% above that, capped at 10% of the monthly fee.
Three or more outages within 90 days add 5% to the service credit (still subject to the cap).
Duplicate or incorrect charges are credited in full within 5 business days.
Invoices match the contracted monthly fee of INR 120,000 plus approved add-ons.
Incidents involving legal claims or personal/patient data must be reviewed by the Compliance Lead before any resolution is offered.
